name: attack-patterns
description: Use this skill when the user says 'SSRF', 'HTTP request smuggling', 'insecure deserialization', 'MITRE ATT&CK mapping', 'vulnerability class deep dive'. Explains the mechanical root cause of common web/network vulnerability classes and maps them to MITRE ATT&CK for threat modeling and architectural hardening. Defensive and educational only. Do NOT use for: generating working payloads, SIEM detection rules (use security/detection-engineering), or secrets handling (use security/secrets-management).
